notes: Original selected historical85.1139% method anchor only; actual paired reference is existing full matching local BASEs from code31467086. No baseline retraining or CP inheritance.

Original F/SIG_TIME_X3/unified centered physicalSinc, RDrop1/LS.01/ordinaryAug/oldgate-ownEMA-cos/defaultheadjoint unchanged; no satellite train/test. SourceL6300/U56700hidden/V27000 original physical roles reused.

Use original shallow/middle mean/std descriptors with detached batch mean/std, L2 normalization, temp.2; sameTX differentRX positives, differentTX negatives, no sameTXsameRX negatives. Two original RDrop forwards reuse actual same augmentedIQ.

For each valid anchor positive logsum P, negative logsum N, mean positive score M, npos K: native=log(exp(P)+exp(N))-M-logK; DCL=N-M-logK; q=exp(N-logaddexp(P,N)); Q_DCL=stopgrad(q)*DCL. Gradientnative=q*gradientDCL+(1-q)*gradient(P-M-logK), where coefficients evaluated then detached. Multi-positive extension, not claim canonical singlepositiveDCL equivalence.

Only replaces native SupCon term with candidate; all6classes equal original anchor mean, no weakclass weighting. Original5warm+10ramp to.1; no new forward/optimizer/params/memorybank/teacher. Negative finite loss valid, no clamps.

InitialQ_DCL/DCL2701 both fixedfinal50 then clean-test. Before any candidate target: expand each arm unchanged2702/03 iff BOTHsourceweak recalls strictly improve,otherTX>=BASE-.25pp,overall>=BASE,worstRX>=BASE-.25pp,nozero features. No target feedback/reorder/reseed.

Weak14-7/20-19 fixed from sourceV only before this run. Q_DCL removes positivecompetition gradient at originalqscale; DCL further changesgradientmagnitude. Difference not pure direction at matchednorm.
Source-only covariance precision diagnostic all3 failed and fully preserved; no Vmatrix inherited. PriorSAM/risk/featurechallenge/gap/gradient-conflict results not silently rerun or stacked.

Focused math and CPU/CUDA actualF flow checks PASS; 13protocolnegatives; entire6 head aux gradientsNone/main exactoriginal, realCP noquery CPU smoke once then discard, physicalSinc/EMA/export pass. Two early failing assertions were test capturelocation errors (outer adapter/reference calls and functional Sinc bypass modulehook), fixed by checking actual legacyIQcapture and second method directly; no realtraining/target affected.

One unique independentP0P1 review PASS; no direct defects found. LocalGPU0 only/max3global/CPUscore1/RAM4.5GiB; oneimmutable release/output, archivecompareonce, releasecompile/postlaunch PIDCWDcmdGPUlog; healthy oldtasks preserved.
No new independentblind/Phase2/satellite claim; sourceV seenRX descriptive. Allnegative targetresults retained. Implementation/config and curated results commitpush with independent remoteOID.
DCL primarysource https://www.ecva.net/papers/eccv_2022/papers_ECCV/papers/136860653.pdf; published image performance is not evidence for this CVS implementation.
